# yara-x-detection-rules

> A YARA-X detection-engineering repository: rules, synthetic fixtures, and a self-hosted CI gate. Dedicated to the public domain under CC0.

Start with [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) if you are an agent, or [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and [docs/handbook.md](docs/handbook.md) if you are a person. The rule contract is the table in the README. Do not add live malware; fixtures are synthesized at test time. Validate locally with:

`make lint` (compile + meta/lifecycle/uniqueness/string policies + `yr fmt`)

`make test` (synthetic positives and negatives in `tests/cases.py`)

`make quality` (ruff, ruff format, mypy, pytest, bandit)

`make ci` also runs coverage/health checks and the goodware FP gate; it needs a local `tests/goodware/` tree. After changing a rule, increment `version` and `modified`, then run `make fmt && make lint && make test && make coverage && make health`.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): overview, rule contract, CI, YARA-X notes
- [Portuguese README](README.pt-BR.md): same content in pt-BR
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): layout, local commands, scope lint, time budget, common YARA-X mistakes
- [Handbook](docs/handbook.md): writing guide (Portuguese, with an English note on top)
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): contribution checklist
- [Rule contract (English)](README.md#rule-contract): naming, required meta, status, purpose, scope lint
- [Rule contract (pt-BR)](README.pt-BR.md#contrato-de-uma-regra): the same table in Portuguese
- [tests/cases.py](tests/cases.py): positive and negative fixtures per rule
